references.label: Consumption
references.source: Hand calculation: the WLTC case's 14.05 kWh/100 km (its own run, 20 °C, Climate Control off) plus the heating and the denser air. Heating: the Climate Control's demand table gives 4.5 − 0.3 × 1.5 = 4.05 kW of heat at −7 °C; the PTC heater turns 1 kW of electricity into 1 kW of heat, plus the 0.2 kW blower: 4.25 kW for 1,800 s = 2.125 kWh, 9.13 kWh/100 km over 23.27 km. Air: rho = p / (R·T) = 101,325 / (287.05 × 266.15) = 1.326 kg/m³, 10.1 % more than 1.204 at 20 °C. Air drag over the WLTC trace, ½ × 1.204 kg/m³ (20 °C) × 0.27 × 2.31 m² × Σv³·Δt (11.98 × 10⁶ m³/s²), is 1.249 kWh at the wheels, 5.37 kWh/100 km over the cycle's 23.27 km; taken as the same at the battery (driving, drag costs about 1/0.9 of it; braking, it takes about 0.9 of it from recuperation): +10.1 % of 5.37 = +0.54. 14.05 + 9.13 + 0.54 = 23.73 kWh/100 km (energy at the battery terminals, so the battery's own losses do not count)

references.label: Consumption
references.source: Hand calculation: the WLTC case's 14.05 kWh/100 km (its own run, 20 °C, Climate Control off) plus the air-conditioning, less the thinner air. Cooling: the demand table gives 2.65 kW of cooling at 35 °C; the compressor's COP is 0.35 × the Carnot value between the evaporator at 21 − 15 = 6 °C (279.15 K) and the condenser at 35 + 15 = 50 °C: 0.35 × 279.15 / 44 = 2.22, so 2.65 / 2.22 = 1.19 kW, plus the 0.2 kW blower: 1.39 kW for 1,800 s = 0.697 kWh, 2.99 kWh/100 km over 23.27 km. Air: rho = 101,325 / (287.05 × 308.15) = 1.146 kg/m³, 4.9 % less than at 20 °C. Air drag over the WLTC trace, ½ × 1.204 kg/m³ (20 °C) × 0.27 × 2.31 m² × Σv³·Δt (11.98 × 10⁶ m³/s²), is 1.249 kWh at the wheels, 5.37 kWh/100 km over the cycle's 23.27 km; taken as the same at the battery (driving, drag costs about 1/0.9 of it; braking, it takes about 0.9 of it from recuperation): −4.9 % of 5.37 = −0.26. 14.05 + 2.99 − 0.26 = 16.78 kWh/100 km
